exposure: Quality improvement initiative to optimize early non-invasive respiratory support
outcome: Invasive mechanical ventilation exposure in the first week of life
cohort: Preterm infants born at <32 weeks gestation and admitted to the NICU on non-invasive respiratory support.
finding: Invasive mechanical ventilation exposure for infants born at <32 weeks gestation decreased from 38% to 25% following the creation of a quality improvement initiative.
followup_time: First week of life (for invasive mechanical ventilation exposure)
gest_age: Preterm infants born at <32 weeks gestation, with a specific focus on infants >=26 weeks gestation.
